caption: The drawing depicts a flat, symmetrical black garment or accessory with a rounded, apron-like shape. The central section is gathered at the top, creating vertical pleating. Two cords extend from the upper corners, each terminating in a long, black tassel. Decorative red stitching is visible running along the edges and down the three main vertical sections of the object. Additional red embroidered designs appear near the lower edge—one central, tree-like motif at the bottom middle, and two symmetrical, floral or abstract motifs at the lower left and right sides. The entire item is set against an unadorned, light beige background. The artist's signature, "Rex Bush," is located in the lower right corner.
title: Silk Apron
